creator_request: Montage of my night at the BayArena: my friend Taha invited me to his VIP box for Bayer Leverkusen vs 1. FC Nürnberg in the DFB-Pokal. Put everything in the order I filmed it, starting with the train ride. Make it all vertical, no black bars. Skip the photo of the empty train seat, and use only one of the two photos of the view from our box. Keep the sound only on the train clip with the announcement "Nächster Halt: Leverkusen Mitte" and mute everything else. Title: "Pokalnacht in Leverkusen 🔴⚫". Make it 25 seconds. Suggest a song but don't add it.
